image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a wood rabbit (cottontail) in a natural grassy environment. The rabbit is facing right, with its head and upper torso clearly visible. It has brown and grey fur, large dark eyes, and upright ears. A blade of grass obscures the lower part of its mouth.

selected_experts.reason: Primary verification that the subject is indeed a wood rabbit/cottontail and not a similar species or AI hallucination.
To verify the structural integrity of the visible head, neck, and ear connections, ensuring no fusion artifacts.
To analyze the fine-grained details of the fur for signs of AI smearing, repetition, or unnatural sharpness.
To check for edge bleeding between the complex fur edges and the background grass.

focus_areas: Fur texture consistency vs background blur
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection of the grass blade and the rabbit's mouth. AI often fails at correct occlusion, either blending the grass into the fur or creating a 'floating' effect. Also, scrutinize the inner ear texture for unnatural smoothness or pattern repetition.
